items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I know the Kid Sheik, Kid so and so.

ctx.x: Bert Robinson. He was from Shreveport, Louisiana. And Jackie could play just like Ball, I mean just like Bird. And they hooked up that night, you know ‘cause Cannonball, he was out of school then but he come back, they had a jam session after the game and the marching band played, so we brought our hero, Bert Robinson. And they hooked up playing man, it was Hella Tella Captain. A lot of people say Cannonball cleaned him out, but I really say Bert Robinson cleaned him out, and Bert is still living. He’s in…

You tailored your own nickname. I’ll be darned. When you do these week long things at these jazz camps, if you had to prioritize what you want these students to go away with from it, is there a couple of things that you think are really important?
